description: Listed building consent for Internal alterations to second floor including removal of a non original internal wall and raising of lobby floor level to accomate drainage pipes. Minor external alteration to soil vent pipe on second floor roof terrace
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (A712/L1, A712/PM01, A712/PM02, A712/PM03, A712/PL01, A712/PL02, A712/PL03, A712/F01, Heritage Statement and Design & Access Statement Received: 04/05/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
